<ParamField body="aria-hidden" type="Booleanish">
  Mark decorative swatches as hidden from assistive technology.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="aria-label" type="string">
  Accessible name when the caller supplies role="img".
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="className" type="string">
  CSS class merged with the swatch class.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="color" type="string">
  CSS color that overrides the background; the border still uses `colorName`.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="colorName" type="&quot;amber&quot; | &quot;blue&quot; | &quot;bronze&quot; | &quot;brown&quot; | &quot;crimson&quot; | &quot;cyan&quot; | &quot;gold&quot; | &quot;grass&quot; | &quot;gray&quot; | &quot;green&quot; | &quot;iris&quot; | &quot;jade&quot; | &quot;lime&quot; | &quot;mint&quot; | &quot;orange&quot; | &quot;pink&quot; | &quot;plum&quot; | &quot;purple&quot; | &quot;red&quot; | &quot;ruby&quot; | &quot;sky&quot; | &quot;tomato&quot; | &quot;turquoise&quot; | &quot;violet&quot; | &quot;yellow&quot;" required>
  Theme color used for the background and border. Required even when `color` overrides the background.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="ref" type="Ref&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;">
  Ref to the swatch div, or the element supplied through render.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="render" type="ReactElement&lt;unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor&lt;any&gt;&gt; | ComponentRenderFn&lt;HTMLProps, {}&gt;">
  Element or render callback composed through Base UI useRender.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="style" type="CSSProperties">

</ParamField>

<ParamField body="variant" type="&quot;circle&quot; | &quot;default&quot;">

</ParamField>
